text:
```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: Setup PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '8.1'
        extensions: mbstring, intl
        coverage: none
        
    - name: Install Composer dependencies
      run: |
        composer install --no-progress --no-suggest
        
    - name: Run PHPStan
      run: |
        vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --level=7 --error-format=checkstyle src/ | tee phpstan-report.xml
      continue-on-error: true
      
    - name: Run PHPUnit tests
      run: |
        vendor/bin/phpunit --verbose
        
    - name: Validate branch alias
      run: |
        # Check if branch alias is set correctly in composer.json
        BRANCH_ALIAS=$(jq -r '.extra."branch-alias"."dev-main"' composer.json)
        if [[ "$BRANCH_ALIAS" == "dev-main" ]]; then
          echo "Branch alias is correctly set to dev-main"
        else
          echo "ERROR: Branch alias is not set to dev-main"
          exit 1
        fi
        
    - name: Verify PHP syntax
      run: |
        find . -name "*.php" -exec php -l {} \; | grep -v "No syntax errors detected"
        
    - name: Check for required files
      run: |
        if [ ! -f "composer.json" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: composer.json not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        if [ ! -f "README.md" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: README.md not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        if [ ! -f "LICENSE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: LICENSE not found"
          exit 1
        fi
```
